newsitem.title: BRUNEI: Brunei, Thailand agree to closer economic ties.
newsitem.headline: Brunei, Thailand agree to closer economic ties.

text.p: Brunei's Sultan Hassanal Bolkiah and Thai Prime Minister Chavalit Yongchaiyudh have agreed to broaden economic cooperation between their countries, Brunei government sources said on Wednesday.
Chavalit, who arrived in Brunei's capital on Wednesday for a brief visit, had an audience with Hassanal.
They discussed, and agreed on ways to diversify cooperation in business and investment, the sources in Brunei's finance ministry said. They could not, however, provide any further details.
Officials said crude oil comprised almost all of Thailand's imports from Brunei while rice constituted the bulk of Brunei's imports from Thailand.
Trade between the two countries totalled 403 million Brunei dollars ($284 million) last year, officials said.
